title: For migrations whose related instance is in the “shelved_offloaded” VM stat
question: For migrations whose related instance is in the “shelved_offloaded” VM state, list each migration status and migration type where the migration count is greater than the average migration count across all such (status, migration_type) groups, showing the migration count and the minimum total memory (MEMORY_TOTAL) for those migrations, along with the memory variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) (MEMORY_MB) for the “shelved_offloaded” VM state among instances that have system metadata with KEY = 'image_image_type'. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base_migrations AS (
  SELECT m.status, m.migration_type, m.id AS migration_id, m.memory_total, i.uuid AS instance_uuid
  FROM migrations m
  JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded'
),
filtered_instances AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT i.uuid
  FROM instances i
  JOIN instance_system_metadata sm ON i.uuid = sm.instance_uuid
  WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' AND sm.`key` = 'image_image_type'
),
group_counts AS (
  SELECT bm.status, bm.migration_type,
         COUNT(bm.migration_id) AS migration_count,
         MIN(bm.memory_total) AS min_memory_total
  FROM base_migrations bm
  WHERE bm.instance_uuid IN (SELECT uuid FROM filtered_instances)
  GROUP BY bm.status, bm.migration_type
),
avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(migration_count) AS avg_migration_count FROM group_counts),
qualifying_groups AS (
  SELECT gc.status, gc.migration_type, gc.migration_count, gc.min_memory_total
  FROM group_counts gc CROSS JOIN avg_count ac
  WHERE gc.migration_count > ac.avg_migration_count
),
memory_stats AS (
  SELECT VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_stddev
  FROM instances i
  WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded'
    AND i.uuid IN (SELECT uuid FROM filtered_instances)
)
SELECT qg.status, qg.migration_type, qg.migration_count, qg.min_memory_total,
       ms.memory_variance, ms.memory_stddev
FROM qualifying_groups qg CROSS JOIN memory_stats ms
ORDER BY qg.status, qg.migration_type

       MIN(m.memory_total) AS min_memory_total,
       (SELECT VARIANCE(i2.memory_mb)
          FROM instances i2

         WHERE i2.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded'

FROM migrations m
JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid
WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded'
GROUP BY m.status, m.migration_type
HAVING COUNT(*) > (
    SELECT AVG(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt

        JOIN instances i2 ON i2.uuid = m2.instance_uuid
        WHERE i2.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded'
